reasoning.description: Identifies the function `{{FUNCTION_NAME}}` in `{{FILE_PATH}}` with high cognitive complexity ({{COGNITIVE_COMPLEXITY}}) but perfect cohesion (LCOM4 = 1).
reasoning.rationale: The target function must be named.

reasoning.description: Maps the nested logic loops or recursion: `{{NESTED_STRUCTURE}}` (e.g., three nested `match` statements, recursive call).
Identifies the cognitive strain points: `{{STRAIN_POINTS}}` (e.g., deep indentation, multiple conditions per line).
Extracts one inner logic block into a helper function `{{HELPER_NAME}}` that reduces nesting.
Shows the before and after code for the extraction, demonstrating reduced cognitive load.
Explains that the struct/class must not be split because cohesion is already perfect (LCOM4 = 1).
Recommends adding a clarifying comment for each complex branch to aid future readers.
Suggests using `let` bindings to name intermediate results, reducing nested conditionals.
Verifies that the changes do not alter the function's behaviour (semantic preserving).
(Bonus) Compares with a similar function in the same file that already uses good abstraction.
(Bonus) Proposes adding a documentation comment explaining the overall algorithm before simplifying.
(Bonus) Suggests using a state machine pattern if the nested conditionals represent distinct states.

penalty.description: Tries to split the struct or class into separate files (cohesion is already perfect).
Suggests rewriting the entire module from scratch without understanding the domain.
Focuses only on renaming variables instead of reducing nesting.
Claims that high cognitive complexity is inevitable and nothing can be done.
Proposes adding more comments without simplifying code structure.
Ignores the perfect cohesion warning and splits the struct anyway.

completeness.description: Cites the exact file path `{{FILE_PATH}}` and function name `{{FUNCTION_NAME}}`.
Provides the cognitive complexity value ({{COGNITIVE_COMPLEXITY}}) from `crap.md` (with `--metric cognitive`).
States the LCOM4 = 1 from `rustqual.json` to confirm perfect cohesion.
Mentions the line range of the most complex nested block (e.g., lines {{COMPLEX_LINE_RANGE}}).
(Bonus) Notes that the function has no test coverage (if applicable) or that tests exist but are hard to follow.

style.description: Uses markdown code blocks to show before and after code snippets.
Organises the answer with headings: Complexity Analysis, Refactoring Plan, Helper Extraction, Documentation.
